description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named DebugSettings that provides a graphical debugging interface for an application. It includes sections for app info, gateway management, logs, ports, paths, quick actions, and canvas interactions. It also contains associated functions for performing debug operations such as port checks, tunnel resets, model reloads, and canvas evaluations.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: A custom GroupBoxStyle for consistent styling of sections in the DebugSettings view.

methods.name: runPortCheck
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check of gateway ports and updates the port reports accordingly.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel for the gateway and rechecks port statuses.

methods.name: requestKill
methods.description: Handles a request to kill a port listener, either prompting confirmation or directly killing the process.

methods.name: killConfirmed
methods.description: Sends a kill command to a process ID and updates the UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: chooseCatalogFile
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for selecting a model catalog file, then triggers reloading models.

methods.name: reloadModels
methods.description: Loads and counts models from the specified catalog file, updating UI state with results or errors.

methods.name: sendVoiceDebug
methods.description: Sends a debug voice command asynchronously and updates status/error states.

methods.name: revealApp
methods.description: Reveals the application bundle in Finder.

methods.name: saveRelayRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path for the gateway process manager.

methods.name: loadSessionStorePath
methods.description: Loads the session store path from configuration.

methods.name: saveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Saves the current session store path to configuration.

methods.name: canvasPresent
methods.description: Displays the directory for the specified canvas session.

methods.name: canvasWriteSamplePage
methods.description: Generates a sample HTML page and writes it to a session directory, then opens it in Canvas.

methods.name: canvasEval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the Canvas session and updates the result.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the Canvas session and updates the path.
